text.p: The odds on Arsenal to lift the English premier league title were cut from 5-1 to 4-1 after their 2-0 win over Leicester at Highbury on Saturday.

Six weeks ago Arsenal were ranked as 33-1 outsiders but their odds have continually dropped following recent wins over Everton, Nottingham Forest, Southampton, Chelsea and now Leicester. They also have a relatively easy run-in compared to Manchester United and Liverpool.
However bookmakers Ladbrokes still put their faith in United who they rate as 9-4 on for the title with Liverpool second favourites at 7-2.
